_comment: Quick-pick groups of app UI locales that `champollion init` expands (`--langs european,ja`). A convenience for app developers choosing which locale files to create — not a statement about any language, its region or its speakers. Edit HERE, never in code: init.js, its wizard hint and `champollion help init` all read this file (bundled into the CLI by `npm run sync:shared`). Codes are CLDR locale codes, in the order init writes them.
